The exact finite cyclic read-image count, parity correction, and proof of the only duplicate periodic labeled paths were not implied by the inspected statements. No equivalent or stronger covering item emerged from direct published/prior research records searches; residual risk concerns unindexed sofic-shift periodic-output counts.
residual_risks: The matrix and its Perron spectral radius are previously published; they are not original claims.
An equivalent cyclic image count may exist under periodic labeled shifts or zeta functions in unindexed literature.
The two related published repository results were compared through accessible summaries, not full proof text.

Classical general-purpose sofic-shift zeta-function algorithms apply to this finite graph, so the claim is the specific exact evaluated count and alternating multiplicity classification, not an independently novel general algorithm.

value.rationale: The natural finite-length zero-error capacity of a noiseless cyclic transverse-read channel is distinct from the already known open-boundary asymptotic rate. Its all-period exact count and the fully classified even-period overcount resolve the operational difference between labeled closed paths and observable read vectors and give an exact constrained-coding benchmark. The parity effect is bounded so no asymptotic rate gain is asserted.
